Today I spawn into a world that's only emerald blocks.
Can I make progress and eventually beat the game? Let's find out!

Datapack: https://modrinth.com/mod/block-swap

This is a Minecraft challenge. It's Hardcore difficulty. I almost died many times in this hardcore run. I had half a heart in this Hardcore video. This is the hardest Minecraft challenge I've done. I made an emerald farm in hardcore mode. I made an easy villager trading farm in Minecraft. The entire world is made of emerald blocks. This is an insane Minecraft datapack mod. It's like a Minecraft 100 days challenge. I became the richest and most overpowered Minecraft player!

#minecraft  #minecraftchallenge #survival #minecrafthardcormode
